title: Safe lookup
prompt: Return the value stored under key in data. If the key is not in the dictionary, return -1 instead of crashing. (Try running the starter as-is to see what the crash looks like.)
signature: func solve(data: Dictionary, key: String) -> int:
starter:
func solve(data: Dictionary, key: String) -> int:
	return data[key]
hint: `if key in data:` checks whether the key exists. (Shortcut: `data.get(key, -1)` does the whole job.)
